theme.designMd:
# Portfolio Scrollytelling Design System

Polished, professional dark UI. Calm reveals, restrained motion, content first.
Carries over the current site look: slate background, emerald accent.

## Colors
| Role | Hex |
|---|---|
| Background | #0F172A (slate-900) |
| Background deep | #020617 (slate-950) |
| Surface / card | #1E293B (slate-800) |
| Border | #334155 (slate-700) |
| Text | #F1F5F9 |
| Muted text | #CBD5E1 |
| Accent (emerald) | #34D399 -> #059669 gradient, used for highlighted words and the active progress dot |

## Typography
Inter. H1 56px/1.2, H2 32px/1.3, body 18px/1.6, labels 12px uppercase tracking-wide. Highlighted words (`<b>`) use the emerald gradient.

## Shape and spacing
Radius 12px. 8px spacing grid. Thin 1px borders, soft shadows, no glows.

## Layout and motion
- Desktop: two columns. Text steps scroll on the left, the visual stays pinned on the right (sticky, 100svh).
- Mobile: stacked, no pinning, visual sits inline above each step.
- Slim progress rail on the right edge: one dot per chapter, active dot is emerald, labels on hover. Becomes a top progress bar on mobile.
- Starfield particles stay as the fixed backdrop.
- Motion: fades and small translates under 0.5s; inactive steps at 25% opacity. All motion off under prefers-reduced-motion.

## Chapters
1. Hello: name, role, tagline.
2. Person: hobbies (video games, camping, kayaking) and mentoring. Photos on the sticky panel.
3. Career: pinned timeline. Each step swaps the sticky card (company, role, period, stack).
4. Skills + AI: steps through Frontend, Backend, Cloud and DevOps, Testing, then "How I work with AI". Sticky panel shows tech logos, then an AI workflow diagram.
5. Contact: links and CV downloads.

screens.prompt:
Desktop two-column pinned narrative chapter 'Career' scrollytelling timeline page. Dark slate theme (#0f172a / slate-900 background) with luminous emerald (#34D399 / emerald-400) accents.

TopNavBar at the top with navigation links: 'Hello', 'Person', 'Career' (marked active with emerald accent), 'Skills + AI', 'Contact', and a 'Resume' action button.

Right-side floating progress rail (SideNavBar) fixed on the right displaying the 5 scrollytelling chapters:
1. 01 Hello
2. 02 Person
3. 03 Career (ACTIVE step, checked/highlighted emerald dot indicator and glowing emerald text)
4. 04 Skills + AI
5. 05 Contact

Main Two-Column Layout (Pinned narrative chapter layout):
- Chapter header badge: '03 // EXPERIENCE & JOURNEY' in monospace uppercase tracking-wider text with emerald pill indicator. Large display title 'Career Odyssey' or 'The Trajectory', with subtitle describing the evolution from academic foundation to senior engineering leadership.

- Left Column (Vertical Timeline):
  A clean, elegant vertical timeline running down the column with connected vertical track lines.
  Step 1: PXL University College - Applied Computer Science (Software Engineering degree), foundation in algorithms, systems & software architecture.
  Step 2: Full-Stack Software Engineer at TechScale / Digital Agency - Building high-traffic distributed web platforms and cloud microservices.
  Step 3 (ACTIVE STEP - highlighted with glowing emerald marker / pill badge, ring-4 ring-emerald-500/20 border-emerald-400 bg-slate-800/80 card, active beacon pulse): Senior Staff / Lead Frontend Architect at Nova Systems - Leading core design system architecture, scrollytelling interactive products, and AI integration.
  Step 4: Principal AI Interface Engineer / Design Engineer - Pioneering next-gen human-AI canvas interfaces and agentic workflows.
  Step 5: Independent Tech Advisor & OSS Contributor.

- Right Column (Sticky Spotlight Card):
  Sticky top-28 panel pinned alongside the timeline that corresponds specifically to the ACTIVE step (Step 3: Nova Systems - Senior Staff / Lead Frontend Architect):
  - Company emblem / icon and name: Nova Systems
  - Role badge & Title: Lead Frontend Architect
  - Period & Location: 2021 – Present • San Francisco / Remote
  - Executive Overview: Deep narrative dive into achievements, leading the next-gen web platform, reducing latency by 42%, and driving the AI-first canvas transformation.
  - Key Impact Metrics: 3 stats cards in emerald grid (e.g., 42% Performance Boost, 140K+ Weekly Devs, 99.98% Uptime).
  - Technology Stack Chips: Pill tags with technology logos/names (TypeScript, React 19, Tailwind CSS, WebGL, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, Python, Docker).
  - Action link / secondary button: 'View Case Study & Artifacts' with external link arrow icon.

Polished styling: deep slate-950 backdrop, subtle glassmorphism borders (slate-800), emerald-400 highlights, glowing status badges, refined typography, and restrained modern developer portfolio aesthetics.

outputComponents.text:
I've designed the **Career** scrollytelling timeline screen for your portfolio on desktop, perfectly aligned with the dark slate and emerald design system.

### Key Highlights:
1. **Pinned Chapter Header & Navigation**:
   - Clean top navigation with the `Career` section active.
   - Pinned scrollytelling progress rail on the right highlighting **Chapter 03 (Career)** with an emerald active indicator.

2. **Left Column — Interactive Vertical Timeline**:
   - Begins with foundational education at **PXL University College** (Applied Computer Science / Software Engineering).
   - Follows consecutive career milestones with connected vertical timeline tracks.
   - **Active Step Highlight**: Lead Frontend Architect at Nova Systems is prominently accentuated with a luminous emerald status badge, illuminated timeline node, and emerald border focus ring.

3. **Right Column — Sticky Spotlight Card**:
   - Stays pinned alongside the timeline to detail the active role at **Nova Systems**.
   - Displays role title, tenure (`2021 – Present`), location, executive summary, and key impact metric cards.
   - Includes technology stack chips (TypeScript, React 19, Tailwind CSS, WebGL, Next.js, Node.js, GraphQL, Python, Docker) and a case study CTA.

outputComponents.suggestion: Add interactive hover/click states so clicking another timeline step switches the sticky card
Add smooth scroll-driven animations with CSS and subtle motion transitions
Design the mobile responsive version of this Career timeline screen
